days.proposal_contribution: P1 (EIA window doctrine - extends daytype.eia_preprint_overextension_gate + the D lens; general, n=4 spanning g17/g22): the EIA pre-print window is REOPEN->10:30, never 08:00->10:30. When the gate fires (>=2 limbs), the chain's final delivery tends to run in the OVERNIGHT/early-morning seam and EXHAUST AT the print: the print's first impulse runs the stops to a MARGINAL new extreme (within ~1 tick-cluster of the overnight extreme), and delivery-vs-absorption in the first minutes decides the session - absorbed flush = the turn (turn_et at/within minutes of 10:30), and the post-print leg belongs to the COUNTER side. Instances: 0702/g22 (overnight -480 chain-aligned, flush to -530 at 10:30:08 on a hair-bullish print, absorbed, +690 counter-leg); 0625/g22 (mirror: pre-print +850 high 09:01, post-print low 10:48, round-trip to -40); 0416/g17 and 0430/g17 (the gate's founding cascade pair: bleed into print, print rallies counter). Consequences: (a) blind falsifier/timing windows on print days must bind the FULL reopen->print stretch - my 0702 falsifier named 08:00-10:30, never fired, and the decomposition failed anyway in the overnight; (b) when the gate fires, assign the chain's residual delivery to the OVERNIGHT window and give the post-print window to the counter side - I did the exact opposite windowing blind (+40 overnight, chain-sided print leg) and both were wrong-signed; (c) sharpening for magnitude.catalyst_condition_sort: on exhaustion-class prints (gate >=2) the Thursday up-size prior applies to RANGE/two-way travel, NOT to net - 0702 delivered 1,380 of leg travel and a 0 net; 0625 delivered 1,350 of range and -40. P2 (covering-quality cap = the S109 asymmetric slope's up-side made mechanical; general, spanning g18/g22): summer-hill UP-legs are covering-financed and self-capping. The G18 doctrine key already records the discriminator (covering-absorbed UP vs aligned-delivered DOWN, the block the price-walled blind missed); G22 week 2 repeats it at day scale: every up-leg in the hill's crest week ran NEGATIVE total signed flow with absorb flags (0630 +790 on -5,573 absorb; 0702's +530 reclaim on ph2/ph3 absorb, closed 0; 0703 +410 on -1,005 absorb) while week-1 up-days ran positive flow (0624 +311, 0626 +871). Rule: when an up-leg's conviction is NEGATIVE (rising price on net sell flow), it is the 'up, but only SOME' arm of the asymmetric-slope doctrine - size it at the RECLAIM of the absorbed excursion (absorption_is_reversal's reversal span, full credit, never damped) and DENY the extension beyond the reclaim unless an ALIGNED phase prints; expect extensions to round-trip (0702's +160 high -> 0 close; the 0326-class lens read). This also resolves the apparent tension between absorption_is_reversal ('never a cap') and the shared round-trip clause: the reversal-reclaim gets full size, the post-reclaim EXTENSION is what covering cannot hold. P3 (renewable subtractor two-way check - grid_stack components; n=2 within g22 on a feed born S99, scope-flagged pending a cross-group instance): a CDD-slope up-lean must pass the component check - wind_mwh d/d and est_gas_burn_bcfd d/d must not contradict the weather-implied burn. 0629: wind +62% / burn -4.2 Bcfd VETOES the heat-add for the session (the directive's named unread subtractor - CDD arrived as forecast and gas burn fell); 0702: wind -8% off peak / burn +2.4 to block max CONFIRMS it (and the day's causal turn was absorption at the print, subtractor-consistent).
